# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and follow it. It has what the repo is, where things live, and the domain ownership for Lab 2.

The PR commands are prompt files in `.github/prompts/`. In Copilot Chat (agent mode), run `/start-pr`, `/execute-pr`, or `/review-pr` and give the ticket ID. Tickets are in `backlog/`. PR docs go in `docs/prs/`.
